shared_elements: horizontal registers or bands of repeated marks
outlined forms with sparse interior detail
justification: Both surfaces show schematic figures and repeated rows of small marks arranged in loose horizontal registers, but the actual subject matter differs almost entirely: A is dominated by boats with crews of vertical stroke-figures, stick-limbed humans and long vertical files of dots, while B shows a stack of animals (quadrupeds, a bird with prominent beak and eye, a snake-like ladder form) plus arms/hands and an arcaded band. The only correspondences are generic ones (animals in profile, schematic humans, repeated marks) that any unrelated tradition could produce independently; no distinctive motif recurs in the same relationship.
